ambiguities.text: The exact values of GAS_RIPEMD160 and GAS_RIPEMD160_WORD constants are not explicitly stated
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard EVM values: GAS_RIPEMD160 = 600, GAS_RIPEMD160_WORD = 120. This needs verification against the actual implementation.

ambiguities.text: Behavior with empty input data is not explicitly documented
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume empty input produces the RIPEMD-160 hash of empty string (0x9c1185a5c5e9fc54612808977ee8f548b2258d31), left-padded to 32 bytes.

implicit_assumptions.description: The RIPEMD-160 implementation from hashlib is cryptographically correct and matches the standard specification
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect hash computation would break consensus and potentially enable hash collision exploits

implicit_assumptions.description: Finding RIPEMD-160 collisions remains computationally infeasible for practical attack scenarios
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Collision attacks could compromise Bitcoin-style address schemes that rely on RIPEMD-160

implicit_assumptions.description: The left-padding format (12 zero bytes + 20-byte hash) is consistent across all implementations
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Inconsistent padding would cause consensus failures between nodes

implicit_assumptions.description: Linear gas cost scaling accurately reflects computational complexity of RIPEMD-160
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Underpriced hashing of large inputs could enable DoS attacks
